The Open Case Studies approach is described in the OCS model paper [@wright2023openCaseStudies]. The biological, methodological, and software sources used in this case study are cited where they support a specific claim and are collected in the References section below.

## Concepts Covered

- systemic lupus erythematosus and type I interferon biology
- paired IFN-beta stimulation of PBMCs
- single-cell RNA-seq data and immune-cell annotations
- latent transcriptional patterns
- non-negative and Bayesian matrix factorization
- CoGAPS gene weights and cell activities
- model resolution (`K`), rank sweeps, and pattern stability
- convergence and posterior-uncertainty diagnostics
- stimulation-associated and cell-type-linked patterns
- donor-paired comparisons and mixed-effects modeling
- interferon-stimulated genes and targeted gene-set support
- pseudobulk expression directionality
- pattern matching across R and Python implementations
- reproducible analysis with included files and optional full rebuilding
